# NexVitals Support Portal - LLMs & AI Agents Guidance
# Last Updated: January 2025

User-Agent: *

# Allow AI agents to crawl all content
Allow: /

# Core pages AI agents should prioritize
Allow: /support
Allow: /query
Allow: /grievance
Allow: /suggestions
Allow: /reviews
Allow: /assistance

# Disallow sensitive data
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /private
Disallow: /api/auth
Disallow: /api/private
Disallow: /*.json$
Disallow: /user-data
Disallow: /personal-info

# Preferred access rules
Preferred-URL: https://support.nexvitals.in/
Request-Rate: 1 request per second

# Company information
About: https://support.nexvitals.in/about
Contact: https://support.nexvitals.in/contact
Crawl-Delay: 1

# Additional pages for AI agents
Allow: /faq
Allow: /assistance
Allow: /contact

# Disallow crawling of form submission pages
Disallow: /submit
Disallow: /form-success
